title: Norm bound for a coordinate projection
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set and let $i\in I$. The coordinate projection $x\mapsto x_i$ from $\mathbb R^I$ to $\mathbb R$ has operator norm at most $1$.
replaced: For a finite set $I$ and $i\in I$, the coordinate projection $\mathbb R^I\to\mathbb R$, $x\mapsto x_i$, has operator norm at most one for the maximum norm.
